name: AE Employer Election Operational Dashboard
description: Working-team dashboard for Annual Enrollment: non-completed status detail (by region), stalled-time buckets, multiple-attempts/recent-completion activity, election-type/HSA breakdowns, and a daily timeline. Split off from AE Snap Report on 2026-09-13.

feeds.description: Status / Synod-Region / Election Sub-Type / Date / Year — same shape as AE Snap Report's employerStatus binding (both widgets share AM_EMPLOYER_ENROLLMENT_SUMMARY); Election Sub-Type also carries: the Stalled .../Days and Recently Completed row-kinds (added 2026-09-13, Stalled rescaled 2026-09-16); the Eligible Employee Band row-kind (20+ / 10-19 / 3-9 / Under 3 / Unknown, added 2026-09-14), the only row-kind where Status and Election Sub-Type are both populated together; the 3 attempt-count buckets (Needed 1/2/3+ Attempts, replacing the old single Multiple Attempts stat, 2026-09-18); the 5 Election_Status values (Open/Completed EL/Completed OTP/Default/Default Override, 2026-09-18), which now also carry Synod-Region populated (unlike every other multiplexed row-kind) for the Synod crosstab; and 'HSA Annual YoY'/'HSA One-Time YoY' (Year-tagged, EmployeeCount repurposed to carry SUM($), 2026-09-18). Date rows carry Year too (2026 or 2027) — Timeline renders as a cumulative line chart plus a daily-volume bar chart (2026-09-18), scoped to Completed EL/Completed OTP only.

refresh.description: Re-renders the dashboard from the currently bound data
